correctness.rationale: Root decomposition F(z;s,t)=ze^s(e^t+F(z;-s,-t)/(1-F(z;-s,-t))) exactly records terminal roots and the parity reversal on every child subtree. Differentiation gives F_st=z/(2 sqrt(1-4z))+z/2-z^2, so n>=3 coefficient is (n/2) Catalan(n-1); all-vertex expectation is zero. F_ss and F_tt similarly give Var(X)=n(n-2)/(2n-3) and the explicit leaf-variance formula. Exact exhaustive rooted ordered tree enumeration through n=11 confirms all five moments with 75 independent assertions. The asymptotic correlation 2/sqrt(5) follows from leading variance terms; no CLT is claimed.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The all-vertex imbalance is twice the root-even class size minus n; the signed leaf statistic is the even-leaf count minus the odd-leaf count. Therefore the equivalent formulation is covariance of root-even class size and even-leaf count. Both possible parameterizations were checked. Knowing both marginals or first moments does not imply their covariance. Related counts of the parity of the NUMBER of leaves are distinct from depth parity.

value.rationale: The two signed imbalances are canonical measures of bipartition asymmetry on a rooted tree and of the contribution by terminal vertices. The exact order-n covariance for every size and limiting correlation 2/sqrt(5) show that the optimal affine predictor from global parity explains asymptotically exactly 4/5 of signed-leaf variance. This is a structural dependency magnitude not inferable from the separately known means, and applies to every size n>=3 rather than an arbitrary finite test.
